lines.say: Your birthday was sold at auction. A rich kid has it now.
The city ran out of good dates. Birthdays go to the highest bidder.
On your day, the tower throws a party. Fireworks. Your name is not on the cake.
You get a free new birthday. The city's leftover date.
Thirtieth of February. It never comes. You will never be older. Or celebrated.
Would you buy your birthday back? Write it in the comments.
